item.text: I’ll first check the existing workspace so the application fits the project structure and I can build and verify the pages in the right place.

The workspace is empty, so I’m creating a self-contained application with four navigable views and a shared responsive layout. The catalog, registration form, confirmation dialog, and registered-course table will work together using sample course data.
The page structure and responsive styles are in place. I’m wiring up navigation, search and filters, registration validation, the confirmation dialog, and the live course table now.

item.text:
Implemented the responsive course registration app in [index.html](/work/index.html), [styles.css](/work/styles.css), and [app.js](/work/app.js).

It includes Home, Course Catalog, Registration, and Student Profile views, with search and filters, course cards, a validated registration form, confirmation dialog, and registered-courses table. Accessibility features include semantic page structure, labeled inputs, keyboard focus indicators, screen-reader announcements, and a skip link.

Checked JavaScript syntax with `node --check app.js`.
